snippet.title: Xentron Attack Extended version
snippet.description:
https://gamejolt.com/games/Xentronattack/517018

New version of Xentron Attack is released.

- Added 4 new enemies and 3 new bosses.

- Added musics

- Added 4 new docking weapons.

- Added Mouse controls.

- Lots of improvements in the game balance.
